feature_breed_text: Breed two Pokémon to get an egg, then put it in the hatchery. Eggs hatch as you keep chatting.
feature_catch_text: Pokémon spawn in your server's channels and the first person to type the name catches it. Everything you catch shows up in the dashboard.
feature_duel_text: Challenge another trainer and each turn the bot posts a picture of the battle, then you pick a move by reacting with its number or typing its name. You can also fight an NPC trainer for credits.
feature_progress_text: Missions pay out crystal slime, which you spend in the mission store. The leaderboard ranks trainers across every server.
feature_trade_text: List a Pokémon for credits or buy one from another trainer. A listing stays up until someone buys it or you take it down.
